# pltr project

Project operations using foundry-platform-sdk.

Projects live in spaces and are addressed by RID (ri.compass.main.folder.<id>, like folders). Find a space with 'pltr space list' and its projects with 'pltr project list --space-rid'. Updating a project uses a beta Foundry endpoint (labeled [beta]).

Examples:

        # Create a project in a space (you become its owner)
        pltr project create "My Project" --space-rid ri.compass.main.folder.space123
        # List the projects in a space, or in every space
        pltr project list --space-rid ri.compass.main.folder.space123
        pltr project list --format json
        # Get, rename, and move a project to the trash
        pltr project get ri.compass.main.folder.proj456
        pltr project update ri.compass.main.folder.proj456 --name "New Name"
        pltr project delete ri.compass.main.folder.proj456
        # Organizations
        pltr project add-orgs ri.compass.main.folder.proj456 -o <ORGANIZATION_RID>
        pltr project list-orgs ri.compass.main.folder.proj456
        # Create a project from a template
        pltr project create-from-template -t <TEMPLATE_RID> -v "name=My Project"

9 commands. Shared options (`--profile`, `--format`, `--output`, `--yes`, paging) are left out; [index.md](../index.md) explains the labels. Every option of one command: `pltr commands show <command>`.

### pltr project add-orgs

Apply organizations to a project; they must also be on its space.

`pltr project add-orgs PROJECT_RID --org TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `PROJECT_RID` (RID or path): Project RID (ri.compass.main.folder.<id>; find it with 'pltr project list').
- `--org`, `-o` TEXT (required; repeatable): Organization RID (repeat for several).
- SDK: `filesystem.Project.add_organizations`

### pltr project create

Create a project in a space.

`pltr project create NAME --space-rid TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `NAME`: Display name of the new project (unique in the space; no '/').
- `--space-rid`, `-s` TEXT (required): RID of the space to create the project in (see 'pltr space list').
- `--description`, `-d` TEXT: Project description.
- `--organization-rid`, `-org` TEXT (repeatable): Organization RID to apply to the project (repeat for several); it must also be on the space.
- `--owner-id` TEXT: User or group ID (a UUID) that owns the project (default: you).
- `--owner-type` USER|GROUP: Whether --owner-id is a user or a group (default: USER).
- `--owner-role` TEXT (default: compass:manage): Role ID granted to the owner.
- `--default-role` TEXT (repeatable): Role ID for the project's default roles (repeat for several); it must be in the role set of the space.
- SDK: `filesystem.Project.create`, `admin.User.get_current`

### pltr project create-from-template

Create a project from a project template.

`pltr project create-from-template --template-rid TEXT [OPTIONS]`

- `--template-rid`, `-t` TEXT (required): RID of the project template.
- `--var`, `-v` TEXT (repeatable): Template variable as name=value (repeat for several).
- `--description`, `-d` TEXT: Project description.
- `--org`, `-o` TEXT (repeatable): Organization RID to apply to the project (repeat for several).
- `--default-role` TEXT (repeatable): Role ID for the project's default roles (repeat for several); it must be in the role set of the space.
- SDK: `filesystem.Project.create_from_template`

### pltr project delete

Move a project, and everything in it, to the trash.

`pltr project delete PROJECT_RID [OPTIONS]`

- `PROJECT_RID` (RID or path): Project RID (ri.compass.main.folder.<id>; find it with 'pltr project list').
- **destructive** (asks first; `--yes` skips) · SDK: `filesystem.Project.get`, `filesystem.Resource.delete`
